messages:
Maria Chen (partnerships): Quick sync — we're green to start onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure listings but need legal signoff on trial terms + partner asset releases. Go-live target: 2026-04-15. Any immediate blockers?
Samir Gupta (legal): Noted. Legal needs EULA localization + partner logo release forms and confirmation of trial terms (30d vs 14d). I'll prepare drafts.
Jin Park (product): Packaging notes: must expose a 30-day trial SKU, a paid SKU, and a "BYO key" option for Private. Also need a short support matrix for Dedicated vs Private behavior.
Lucas Meyer (cloudops): Infra ask: we need one publisher IAM role per cloud with example policies. Quick sample for AWS below: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher"
    }
  ]
}
```
Anna Lopez (marketing): Thinking embargo: announce partner listing ~48h after listing goes live so partners can approve quotes. Need partner PR contact + logo legal clearance.
Samir Gupta (legal): We'll need partner-signed asset release + a short letter permitting use of logos in press/console. I'll send a template by EOD.
Maria Chen (partnerships): @Samir link to current draft: https://internal.drive/redwood/marketplace-eula-draft-v1 (private) — please mark redlines.
Jin Park (product): Also will add a small test harness and runbook for SI partners to validate connector behavior with Private. Plan to push to repo: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-tests. Test plan covers token rotation, callback URLs, and onboarding provisioning flows.
Devops Bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created -> https://internal.tools/checklists/marketplace-onboard/28345 (status: draft).
Lucas Meyer (cloudops): Region mapping: us-east-1 (AWS), europe-west1 (GCP), australia-southeast1 (GCP). Azure regions TBD — will add mapping table and failover notes.
Martin Hale (compliance): Heads up — FedRAMP needs were flagged by the sales lead. If we want a FedRAMP SKU we'll need a separate review; that adds ~2–3 weeks.
Samir Gupta (legal): Good call. Recommend we split SKUs: "standard-hosted" (no FedRAMP) + "gov" (FedRAMP gating). Legal will craft terms accordingly.
Maria Chen (partnerships): Agreed. We'll scope non-FedRAMP first to hit the April date, then pipeline FedRAMP. @Anna can you reflect that in comms?
Anna Lopez (marketing): Yep. Drafting timeline + customer-facing copy. I'll include a clear note on compliance/region availability. Will share copy tomorrow.
Maria Chen (partnerships): Action items recap: 1) @Samir — send asset release + EULA localization draft; 2) @Jin — publish test harness + onboarding runbook; 3) @Lucas — IAM templates + region map; 4) @Anna — draft comms and embargo plan; 5) I'll schedule vendor legal sync and collect partner PR contacts.
Samir Gupta (legal): ETA: forms + EULA redlines by 2026-03-26 EOD.
Jin Park (product): ETA: test harness PR + runbook by 2026-03-24 EOD.
Lucas Meyer (cloudops): ETA: IAM templates + region mapping doc by 2026-03-27.
Anna Lopez (marketing): ETA: comms draft by 2026-03-23 morning.
Maria Chen (partnerships): Thanks — scheduling a 30m cross-team sync Thu 10:00 PT to walk the checklist. Invite incoming.
Marketplace Bot: Event created: "Marketplace Onboard — Cross-team sync" Thu 10:00 PT — https://calendar.link/meeting/abc123 
Maria Chen (partnerships): Quick ping to partners (external): @SigmaIntegrations — can you confirm a rep for Thu? Also pinging hardware partner legal to request logo grants.
Samir Gupta (legal): One more: need to confirm whether partners want co-branded trial flow or standalone listing. Co-branding requires additional approvals.
Jin Park (product): If co-branded, product needs a short co-brand config (logo, partner url, quote). I'll draft a minimal schema for the listing metadata.
Lucas Meyer (cloudops): FYI: there is a quota patch in staging that affects publisher role assume-rate — will revert if it blocks onboarding.
Maria Chen (partnerships): Great. I'll compile these notes and update the checklist. If anyone has blockers before Thu, drop them here. :thumbsup:
